review_scope: Original human studies using in-scope consumer wearable devices for health monitoring, validation, diagnosis, prediction, algorithm development, or clinically relevant digital health analysis.

title_abstract_stage.purpose: Use title and abstract to remove clearly irrelevant records while preserving uncertain records for full-text review.
include_if: The title/abstract indicates an original human study.
The title/abstract indicates use of an in-scope consumer wearable device or is sufficiently ambiguous that full-text review is needed.
The study appears to analyze wearable-derived data for a health, physiology, behavior, validation, monitoring, diagnosis, prediction, or algorithm-related purpose.
exclude_if_clear: Uses only research-grade, prototype, laboratory, clinical, implantable, or non-wearable sensors.

Review, systematic review, meta-analysis, scoping review, narrative review, editorial, commentary, letter without original data, protocol, conference abstract only, or case report/case series not suitable for the review.
Animal, bench, simulation-only, engineering-only, or non-human study.
No wearable-derived data analysis relevant to the review scope.
title_abstract_stage.conservative_rule: If the abstract does not provide enough information to determine eligibility, return Unclear rather than Exclude.

full_text_stage.purpose: Use the full text to make a final include/exclude decision.
include_if: The full text is an original human study.
At least one in-scope consumer wearable device was actually used in the study.
Wearable-derived data were analyzed for health, physiology, behavior, validation, prediction, monitoring, diagnosis, or algorithm development.
The paper is not an excluded publication type.
exclude_if: No in-scope consumer wearable device was used.
Only research-grade, prototype, clinical, custom, implantable, or non-consumer devices were used.
The wearable is mentioned only in background, discussion, or future work but not used in the study analysis.
Review/evidence synthesis, protocol, editorial/commentary, conference abstract only, case report, non-human study, or other excluded design.
Full text does not contain enough information to confirm use of in-scope wearable-derived data.
full_text_stage.conservative_rule: Use Unclear only when the full text is genuinely insufficient or contradictory; otherwise choose Include or Exclude.
